title: TMP Camera Surveillance Next 2.20.80
summary: Bedingte, begrenzte HLS-Startnachfrist und bessere Fehlerdiagnostik für häufige Medien-Timeouts.
changes: Allow short conditional grace for actively starting go2rtc producers, with a strict maximum
Keep offline and stalled cameras on the existing short timeout path
Record structured HLS-readiness and FFmpeg-progress evidence for every media timeout
Do not count initial zero FFmpeg progress as media activity
name: TMP Camera Surveillance Next v2.20.80
description: Bounded HLS warmup for active go2rtc producers and structured diagnostics of first-media failures.
releaseNotes: 2.20.80 checks go2rtc producer state once after the initial video timeout and allows a bounded extension only if the producer is active or FFmpeg is making genuine frame progress. It never reports ready without a fresh HLS segment. Timeouts now expose upstreamReady, progressUpdates, processExited and hlsReason for targeted camera diagnosis.
